{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with NaN revenue
invalid_revenue_rows = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isna()]

# Check the status and type of these rows
invalid_revenue_rows[['order_id', 'status', 'type']].head()"}
